rules: Agents, LLM APIs, prompts, MCP servers and agent skills go to the AI folder. A design, video or marketing tool that happens to use AI goes with its function (an AI video editor goes to Video).
Frameworks, general APIs, scraping and coding guides go to Software Development. UI component libraries and design systems go to Design.
Payments, invoices and payment gateways go to Business / Payments, including discussion posts about integrating payments.
OTP, temporary numbers or email, password managers and 2FA go to Business / Identity & Security.
Server dashboards, uptime monitors and self-hosted admin panels go to Infrastructure / Monitoring.
Different pages on the same site (two analytics properties, two docs pages) are separate bookmarks, not duplicates.
'reference' means mainly something to read (a post, a doc, a guide). It is not a catch-all tag.
